svg.title: Occlusion sensitivity
svg.desc: A black patch scans the image in raster order while the corresponding cell of the sensitivity grid fills in; the grid is then resized and normalised.
svg.text: compute_occlusion_sensitivity: slide a black patch, measure the score drop
Real function, toy scorer (template-weighted brownness) in place of the CNN. Implemented in explainability.py but not called by the Streamlit app.
dashed: last row/column is never visited and stays 0
At 299 px the same loop makes 17×17 = 289 occluded passes. A patch value of 0 is black for EfficientNetB3 inputs but
mid-grey for the Inception models, whose preprocessed range is centred on 0.
